capabilities: Style Markdown elements visually without writing CSS
Apply built-in or imported JSON presets
Scope styles to the whole vault or to notes with a CSS class
Set separate light and dark mode styles
Export and share presets as JSON
extras: Not available in the official Obsidian Community Plugins directory; installed via BRAT or manually from GitHub releases. Includes a reset 'Danger Zone' and English/Persian interface language.
intentEvidence: The plugin is designed to work with different Obsidian themes by using Obsidian's built-in CSS variables where possible.
problem: Styling note elements in Obsidian normally requires writing CSS snippets or editing theme files, which is not accessible to non-technical users.

relations.evidence: Inspired by Style Settings and the Minimal Theme
Inspired by Style Settings and the Minimal Theme
BRAT can also keep the plugin updated when new releases are published.

summary: Visual style manager that styles text, headings, blocks, lists, tables, links and embeds without writing CSS, using presets and scopes.
